options.content:
GitHub活動の公開ダッシュボードです。期間は右上の時間範囲で変更できます。

データが表示されない場合は、同期がまだ完了していないか、指定期間に実績がありません。最終同期の状態は下部で確認できます。

targets.rawSql: WITH current_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commit_count), 0) AS value FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() AND metric_at <= $__timeTo()), prior_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commit_count), 0) AS value FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() - ($__timeTo() - $__timeFrom()) AND metric_at < $__timeFrom()) SELECT current_period.value AS "実績", CASE WHEN prior_period.value = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (current_period.value - prior_period.value)::numeric / prior_period.value END AS "前期間比" FROM current_period, prior_period;

WITH current_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pull_request_created_count), 0) AS value FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() AND metric_at <= $__timeTo()), prior_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pull_request_created_count), 0) AS value FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() - ($__timeTo() - $__timeFrom()) AND metric_at < $__timeFrom()) SELECT current_period.value AS "実績", CASE WHEN prior_period.value = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (current_period.value - prior_period.value)::numeric / prior_period.value END AS "前期間比" FROM current_period, prior_period;

WITH current_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pull_request_merged_count), 0) AS value FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() AND metric_at <= $__timeTo()), prior_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pull_request_merged_count), 0) AS value FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() - ($__timeTo() - $__timeFrom()) AND metric_at < $__timeFrom()) SELECT current_period.value AS "実績", CASE WHEN prior_period.value = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (current_period.value - prior_period.value)::numeric / prior_period.value END AS "前期間比" FROM current_period, prior_period;

WITH current_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(completed_issue_count), 0) AS value FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() AND metric_at <= $__timeTo()), prior_period AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(completed_issue_count), 0) AS value FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() - ($__timeTo() - $__timeFrom()) AND metric_at < $__timeFrom()) SELECT current_period.value AS "実績", CASE WHEN prior_period.value = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (current_period.value - prior_period.value)::numeric / prior_period.value END AS "前期間比" FROM current_period, prior_period;

SELECT metric_date AS "日付", commit_count AS "コミット", pull_request_created_count AS "作成PR", pull_request_merged_count AS "マージPR", completed_issue_count AS "完了Issue" FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() AND metric_at <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY metric_date;

SELECT date_trunc('week', metric_at) AS time, SUM(commit_count) AS "コミット", SUM(pull_request_created_count) AS "作成PR", SUM(pull_request_merged_count) AS "マージPR", SUM(completed_issue_count) AS "完了Issue" FROM dashboard.daily_metrics WHERE metric_at >= $__timeFrom() AND metric_at <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT title AS "タイトル", first_closed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo' AS "完了日時" FROM dashboard.completed_issues WHERE first_closed_at >= $__timeFrom() AND first_closed_at <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY first_closed_at DESC;

SELECT last_synced_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo' AS "最終同期日時", status AS "状態", trigger_type AS "実行種別", sync_mode AS "同期モード", repository_succeeded AS "成功リポジトリ数", repository_failed AS "失敗リポジトリ数" FROM dashboard.sync_status;
